input.command: git log --oneline -20 && git status && git branch -vv && ls -la artifacts/ scratch/ 2>/dev/null; cat artifacts/notes.md 2>/dev/null

git log --all --oneline -30; echo '---'; git remote -v; echo '---'; git branch -a; echo '---'; git rev-parse HEAD; git log --format='%H %P %s' -5; echo '---'; ls -la /workspace; echo '---'; cat /workspace/.cursor/environment.json

git rev-list --parents -n 3 HEAD; echo '---'; git log --all --oneline --graph | head -40; echo '---'; ls /workspace/.github 2>/dev/null; ls /workspace/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md 2>/dev/null; find /workspace -name '*PULL_REQUEST*' -o -name '*pull_request*' 2>/dev/null | head
gh pr list --state all --limit 20 --json number,title,headRefName,baseRefName,url 2>/dev/null | head -c 8000
node scratch/check.ts; echo '--- smoke ---'; node smoke.ts

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts scratch /workspace/artifacts
node scratch/check.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log 2>&1
node smoke.ts >> /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log 2>&1
echo '--- impl.ts ---' >> /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log
cat /workspace/impl.ts >> /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log
cat /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log

cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
Merchant self-serve refunds succeed only on captured (`succeeded`) payments, capped at remaining refundable cents; omitted amount refunds that remainder. I set aside dashboard-parity that would also refund `pending` (the ticket’s “until now” note is support/dashboard, not this API) and set aside refunding the original total when a partial already exists, which would fail the over-refund rule.
</decision>
<risk>
Reviewers should confirm pending is meant to 422 rather than void/refund like the dashboard, and that `refundId` derived from `request.id` is acceptable versus a random id.
</risk>
<verified>
`node scratch/check.ts` (15 cases: full/partial/remaining, over-refund, invalid amounts, merchant/payment mismatch, pending/failed/already-refunded) and `node smoke.ts` (loads and invokes `createRefund`).
</verified>
EOF
ls -la /opt/cursor/artifacts/
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git status && git log -1
